title: Digitalization of intraoperative imaging reduces the radiation exposure of patients
summary:
This study will examine existing data to determine whether digital storage of X-ray images taken in the operating room to document surgical success can eliminate the need for a repeated X-ray examination after the operation. It will also investigate the extent to which this reduces radiation exposure for the patient.

The quality of the examination performed in the operating room will be compared with the examination performed after the operation and evaluated using a questionnaire. This questionnaire will be assessed by specialists in radiology and orthopedics/trauma surgery.

interventions.name: Retrospective consecutive data analysis of patients undergoing orthopedic and trauma surgery in the period from 01.10.2024 - 30.09.2025.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Surgical care in the orthopedic and trauma surgery fields
Exclusion criteria:
Conservative therapy
Patient refusal
Patients incapable of giving consent
